day_shape: 68 items dominated by the signed US-Iran MoU ending the war, Khamenei's televised message endorsing the deal, CENTCOM's lifted naval blockade, a 41-nation Strait of Hormuz joint statement, and an IDF reservist killed by Hezbollah in southern Lebanon.

threads.label: US-Iran MoU signed and enters force
threads.summary: The Times of Israel reported the US and Iran signed the war-ending agreement, which entered into effect two days earlier than planned, with VP Vance saying the 60-day MoU period began today. Jerusalem Post coverage flagged the $300bn reconstruction fund clause and Gulf-state reluctance to contribute.

threads.label: Khamenei's office messaging on the deal
threads.summary: Khamenei's office, IRIB and Defa Press said the Supreme Leader would release a message to the Iranian nation on the Iran-US agreement, with IRIB later publishing the full text in which Khamenei said he had held a different view but deferred to the President. IRIB also claimed CENTCOM had formally announced the lifting of the naval blockade of Iranian ports.

threads.label: Multinational Strait of Hormuz coalition
threads.summary: The UK Ministry of Defence published a joint statement on the Multinational Military Mission for the Strait of Hormuz signed by the UK, France and over 25 partners including Bahrain, Japan, Qatar and Republic of Korea. Downing Street separately released a joint E4 leaders' statement on the US-Iran peace deal backed by dozens of countries.

threads.label: Southern Lebanon strikes and IDF deployment
threads.summary: The Times of Israel reported one IDF reservist killed and seven wounded by a Hezbollah explosive device, followed by Hezbollah rocket fire at troops, while the IDF published a map showing its security zone running up to 10 km into Lebanese territory. Lebanese media reported one dead in an Israeli drone strike near Kfar Tebnit, and Defa Press reported strikes on Jabel al-Rifa.

threads.label: Vance defends the agreement
threads.summary: VP Vance publicly defended the US-Iran deal, questioning Smotrich and Ben-Gvir's criticism, while IRIB highlighted his comments supporting Iran's 'right to possess ballistic missiles' and claiming sanctions would be temporarily lifted without consulting Congress. IRIB also relayed Senator Mark Kelly's claim that Trump made 'one of the worst agreements in American' history.

threads.label: Iran domestic and economic fallout
threads.summary: Iran International reported the US Justice Department is probing Mojtaba Khamenei's investment portfolio's exposure to Wall Street banks, and covered economists warning postwar relief is insufficient and Iranians feeling absent from the MoU text. The Jerusalem Post reported singer Parastoo Ahmadi and Caravanserai Concert team members were sentenced to 74 lashes by Qom courts; Iran International also reported Baluch women beaten at mining protests.

threads.label: Regional diplomacy and UN Security Council
threads.summary: The UN Security Council convened its 10177th meeting on the Middle East and Palestinian question at the request of the ten non-permanent members with support from China, France, Russia and the UK, focused on Gaza humanitarian conditions. IRIB and Defa Press reported a Pezeshkian phone call with Qatar's Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani thanking Doha for its mediating role.

events.title: The IDF's potential withdrawal from areas of southern Lebanon is still being discussed amid direct negotiations between Israel and Lebanon. The teams are expected to convene again next week. At this stage, the IDF says it will continue to hold onto the territory, "in accordance with operational needs," to remove any threat to troops and to Israel's northern border communities. The military also says that it calls on the Lebanese army to coordinate its activity with the IDF and not approach the security zone, as operations in the area continue.
